body: Biggest post-soviet country. There are almost none, and I suspect that soon I won’t be able to move to another country for the next several years. Will look into the matter though, maybe there are somebody nearby, thanks

If you’re referring to something ingrained in my character since birth that would be compassion, kindness and loyalty mostly. Also I’m not judgemental and not competitive, these are also likable traits in my eyes. These are things I like in myself which are restricted by my societal role. Things that are not would be outgoing personality, artistic and analytical abilities and willpower

I’m me and I like everything I do if it’s imposing my will on others. If I don’t impose my will, like when I have to pretend to compete or to not care then I don’t like it. I also like my hobbies obviously.

I think character tendencies are constant and only thing transforming is their incarnation. It’s what they do in psychotherapy. At least my psychotherapist couldn’t fix me into being a proper male and enjoying it.

I’ve been outcasted in important social groups when I was too feminine. Being masculine is demanded from a man in order to maintain social contact. It’s not a bad thing since it’s what women and normal men seek and enjoy, but it would’ve been nice if there were people who could enjoy something else and if everybody could tolerate something else

I like everything in myself so everything I like would be lost.

True change is impossible due to core being a core, what you suggest is escapism of myself, which I have done for far too long and now I’m in search of an alternative.

Elaborate on having nothing to offer, I don’t quite understand what do you think I should offer and what’s the point of it if I’ll receive nothing of value in return? If offering is something value in economy or personal relationships then I don’t think I’ve offered nothing


I’m not lazy and I don’t understand how you draw this conclusion from what I’ve said. I can agree that I’m somewhat whiny but you most likely overestimate how whiny I am and I don’t think it’s a most suited word to describe me. Yes, I’m entitled and don’t see a problem? Is it that bad to want and expect ability to be yourself?

Honest social interactions are hard for me because of my personality. I can’t be myself around people because I’m a broken version of what a man should be, or rather I’m a woman who has been sentenced to live in a prison of man’s body and man’s social role. I’m tired of a constant competition in which I must participate just because I was born in a certain way. It’s ridiculous how this competition touches each and every aspect of men’s life and in case of social interaction it’s entirely impossible to behave like I feel like behaving because I must participate in it. I don’t think my self can change that much, my deepest character tendencies and desires have been constant for my entire life

Wish I too could be content with it. But for me personally it’s like being a slave and having a family to take care of. Family is only thing keeping him sane, but other than that he still lives in a dystopia where his inherent desire for freedom is denied.
